parameters.name: plateau_v
parameters.page_figure: Not tabulated. Nearest source: Diagram 10 (Typ. gate charge, VGS = f(QG); ID = 20.1 A pulsed; parameter VDD = 400 V), page 10
parameters.source_ref: raw/infineon-imza65r048m1h-datasheet-en.pdf p.7 Table 7 (no plateau voltage; only plateau CHARGE QGS(pl) = 9 nC) and p.10 Diagram 10
parameters.null_reason: The manufacturer does not state a numeric Miller plateau voltage anywhere in the datasheet. Table 7 (p.7) tabulates only the plateau gate-to-source CHARGE QGS(pl) = 9 nC, plus QGD = 8 nC and QG = 33 nC. Diagram 10 (p.10) plots VGS = f(QG) at VDD = 400 V / ID = 20.1 A, but its plateau region is sloped (not flat) and carries no numeric value, so any single voltage would be a graph digitization rather than a manufacturer-stated value. Per task instruction ('unsupported values stay null with the reason'), the model input is left null.

additional_source_values_not_consumed_by.note: Eon/Eoff switching ENERGY is NOT published in this datasheet. Only switching TIMES (td/tr/td(off)/tf) are given. No switching-energy row exists to mis-apply across gate bias.

eighteen_volt_evidence: Table 5 (p.6): RDS(on) is specified at VGS = 18 V (48 typ / 64 max mohm at 25 C).
Table 6 (p.6): switching times are specified at VDD = 400 V, VGS = 0/18 V, ID = 20.1 A, RG,ext = 1.8 ohm.
Table 7 (p.7): QG / QGS(pl) / QGD are specified at VGS = 0 to 18 V.
Table 2 (p.3): IDM and the VGS = 18 V reverse-drain row use 18 V as the gate bias.

gate_bias_of_every_extracted_number.eoss_j: VGS = 0 V, VDS = 400 V (output-capacitance energy, gate off)

caveats: The recommended turn-OFF is 0 V. The datasheet does not recommend a negative off-bias; -5 V is only the static absolute-maximum lower bound (Table 2).

A -5 V off-bias would sit outside the Table 4 operating range lower bound of -2 V, so a bipolar -5/+18 proposal is NOT source-recommended and would require the M1 application note AN_1907_PL52_1911_144109 plus a declared negative-rail producer.
Table 4 important notice: if the applied VGS exceeds the operating range, RDS(on) and VGS(th) may exceed the datasheet maximum at end of lifetime; Table 2 and the application note must be considered.
Table 2 note: Infineon recommends operating conditions not exceeding 80% of the maximum ratings for optimum lifetime/reliability.
No isolated gate-bias-specific switching-energy row exists because the datasheet publishes only switching times, not Eon/Eoff energies.
